mapper.insert: INSERT INTO storage_slot (slot_code, rack_level_id, width, length, height, destination_x, destination_y, destination_heading, status, reserved_task_id, stored_cargo_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{slotCode}, #{rackLevelId}, #{width}, #{length}, #{height}, #{destinationX}, #{destinationY}, #{destinationHeading}, #{status}, #{reservedTaskId}, #{storedCargoId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, slot_code, rack_level_id, width, length, height, destination_x, destination_y, destination_heading, status, reserved_task_id, stored_cargo_id, created_at, updated_at FROM storage_slot WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT s.id AS slot_id, s.slot_code AS slot_code, r.id AS rack_id, r.rack_code AS rack_code, rl.id AS rack_level_id, rl.level_number AS level_number, s.width AS slot_width, s.length AS slot_length, s.height AS slot_height, s.destination_x AS destination_x, s.destination_y AS destination_y, s.destination_heading AS destination_heading, rl.fork_height AS fork_height, s.status AS status FROM storage_slot s JOIN rack_level rl ON s.rack_level_id = rl.id JOIN rack r ON rl.rack_id = r.id WHERE s.status = 'EMPTY' ORDER BY s.slot_code

SELECT s.id AS slot_id, s.slot_code AS slot_code, r.id AS rack_id, r.rack_code AS rack_code, rl.id AS rack_level_id, rl.level_number AS level_number, s.width AS slot_width, s.length AS slot_length, s.height AS slot_height, s.destination_x AS destination_x, s.destination_y AS destination_y, s.destination_heading AS destination_heading, rl.fork_height AS fork_height, s.status AS status FROM storage_slot s JOIN rack_level rl ON s.rack_level_id = rl.id JOIN rack r ON rl.rack_id = r.id WHERE s.id = #{slotId}
mapper.update: UPDATE storage_slot SET status = 'EMPTY', reserved_task_id = NULL, stored_cargo_id = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{slotId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
